name: KnowMapped Embeds
description: Embeds public KnowMapped maps natively in Publii posts and pages.
author: Education Futures

messageInOptions.text:
Basic shortcode

[knowledge-map id="MAP_UUID"]

Copy the map ID from its public URL. Only public maps can be embedded. Embeds calculate their height automatically from the map and available browser width.

Available options

  • id — required map UUID.
  • title="show|hide" — show or remove the map title.
  • title-align="left|center" — align a visible title.
  • width="normal|wide|full" — article width, 150% article width, or browser width.
  • height="auto|300–1200" — automatic by default; enter pixels only to force a fixed desktop height.
  • frame="show|hide" — control the border, rounded corners, and shadow.
  • background="show|hide" — control the canvas color and grid.
  • exploration="show|hide" — allow movement and zooming or create a static map.

Example

[knowledge-map id="MAP_UUID" title="show" width="wide" frame="hide" background="hide"]

Mobile behavior: maps resize automatically when the screen changes or rotates. Pinch always magnifies the page. In Explore mode, use the map buttons to zoom and drag with one finger to move.

config.name: defaultShowBackground
config.label: Show canvas background and grid
config.note: Disable this together with the frame for a seamless map.

config.name: defaultAllowExploration
config.label: Allow readers to explore maps
config.note: Disable this for static maps with no panning, zooming, or exploration buttons. A shortcode can override this with exploration="show" or exploration="hide".
